hook: America votes: who will control Congress?
caption:
🗳️ US midterms today: all 435 House seats, 35 Senate seats and 36 governors on the ballot. Polls suggest Democrats lead; Trump predicts Republicans hold.
💥 US carries out limited strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island; Iran says a deal is still far off.
⚡ Ukraine says Russia fired 289 drones overnight; an aid-site strike killed at least 31, officials said Tuesday.
💻 North Korea rejects FBI claims it stole $6.3bn from Binance. Binance users: the exchange says it covered 90% of losses.
🎮 Zelda: Ocarina of Time is back, remade for Switch 2.
Which story are you following most today? 👇
Follow @you.didnot.know for your daily brief.

1/5 Congress up for grabs (435)
Americans vote today for all 435 House seats. Results decide Congress for Trump's last two years.
📷 Ktkvtsh (CC BY 4.0) via wikimedia

2/5 US strikes Iran's Qeshm Island (Qeshm)
The US hit Qeshm Island in limited 'defensive' strikes. Iran says a deal remains far off despite talks.
📷 OpenStreetMap (CC BY 4.0) via wikimedia

3/5 Huge overnight attack on Ukraine (289)
Zelensky says Russia fired 289 drones overnight, plus missiles. The attack hit nine regions, causing emergency power cuts.
📷 NiC00L147 (CC BY-SA 4.0) via wikimedia

4/5 North Korea denies Binance hack ($6.3bn)
Kim Yo Jong rejected FBI claims Pyongyang stole $6.3bn. It's the biggest crypto theft on record.
📷 Isokivi (CC BY-SA 3.0) via wikimedia

5/5 Ocarina of Time returns (1998)
Nintendo's 1998 Zelda classic is remade for Switch 2. NPR's review says it lasts 'for generations to come.'
